attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: team_registration_and_standings_init
steps:
  - id: receive_registration_form
    op: receive_form_submission
    params:
      source: admin_team_registration_form
      required_fields:
        - team_name
        - logo
        - league_id
        - season_id
    output: registration_data

  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: "{{registration_data.admin_token}}"
      required_role: admin
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_team_data
    op: validate_data
    params:
      data: "{{registration_data}}"
      rules:
        - field: team_name
          type: string
          min_length: 1
          max_length: 255
          unique_in: teams
        - field: logo
          type: url
          required: true
        - field: league_id
          type: integer
          exists_in: leagues.id
        - field: season_id
          type: integer
          exists_in: seasons.id
    output: validation_result

  - id: insert_team_record
    op: database_insert
    params:
      table: teams
      record:
        name: "{{registration_data.team_name}}"
        logo: "{{registration_data.logo}}"
        league_id: "{{registration_data.league_id}}"
        season_id: "{{registration_data.season_id}}"
        is_active: true
        is_hidden: false
        created_at: "{{now}}"
        updated_at: "{{now}}"
    output: team_record

  - id: initialize_standings_row
    op: database_insert
    params:
      table: standings
      record:
        team_id: "{{team_record.id}}"
        league_id: "{{registration_data.league_id}}"
        season_id: "{{registration_data.season_id}}"
        matches_played: 0
        wins: 0
        draws: 0
        losses: 0
        goals_for: 0
        goals_against: 0
        goal_difference: 0
        points: 0
        created_at: "{{now}}"
        updated_at: "{{now}}"
    output: standings_record

  - id: log_team_creation
    op: audit_log
    params:
      event: team_created
      actor: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
      entity_type: team
      entity_id: "{{team_record.id}}"
      details:
        team_name: "{{registration_data.team_name}}"
        league_id: "{{registration_data.league_id}}"
        season_id: "{{registration_data.season_id}}"
        standings_id: "{{standings_record.id}}"
      timestamp: "{{now}}"
